<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="vi"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><title>Mastermind</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)}
#pal{position:fixed;bottom:10px;left:0;right:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:0 8px;z-index:2}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0f172aee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center;z-index:3}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(42px,1fr));gap:6px;width:min(90vw,480px);max-height:50vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:10px}
button{background:#38bdf8;color:#04202e;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}button:disabled{background:#26334d;color:#7a8aa8;cursor:not-allowed}
</style></head><body><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="h"></div><div id="pal"></div><div id="m"></div><script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=50,K='mg_mastermind',T='🧠 Mastermind',hint='Đoán dãy màu ẩn: chọn màu (chạm/click hoặc phím số), ⌫ để xoá, ✔ (Enter) để gửi. ⚫ = đúng màu đúng chỗ, ⚪ = đúng màu sai chỗ. Màu có thể lặp lại';
let W,H,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0;try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight}onresize=rs;rs();
function menu(){run=0;m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw;font-size:0.9em">${hint}</p>`;const grid=document.getElementById('g');for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=i;b.disabled=i>best;b.onclick=()=>go(i);grid.append(b)}}
function end(w,t){if(!run)return;draw();run=0;if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){best=lv+1;try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}}m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:t||'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><div style="display:flex;gap:10px;"><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button></div>`;ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);bm.onclick=menu}
function go(l){lv=l;m.style.display='none';rs();init();run=1;lt=performance.now()}
function loop(t){lt=t;if(run)draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
const CL=['#ef4444','#22c55e','#3b82f6','#eab308','#a855f7','#f97316','#e5e7eb','#a16207'],EM=['🔴','🟢','🔵','🟡','🟣','🟠','⚪','🟤'];
let cl,nc,tries,S,rows,gs;
function init(){
  // Phân hóa độ khó theo 50 màn chơi
  cl = lv <= 15 ? 3 : lv <= 35 ? 4 : 5; // Độ dài mã cần đoán tăng từ 3 -> 4 -> 5
  nc = Math.min(4 + Math.floor(lv / 10), 8); // Số lượng màu lựa chọn từ 4 -> 8
  tries = Math.max(8, 14 - Math.floor(lv * 0.1)); // Số lượt đoán cho phép
  
  S=Array.from({length:cl},()=>Math.floor(Math.random()*nc));
  rows=[];gs=[];pal.innerHTML='';
  
  for(let i=0;i<nc;i++){
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.style.cssText=`background:${CL[i]};color:#000;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;padding:0`;
    b.textContent=i+1;
    b.onclick=()=>add(i);
    pal.append(b);
  }
  [['⌫',del],['✔',sub]].forEach(([t,f])=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.textContent=t;
    b.style.cssText='width:52px;height:40px';
    b.onclick=f;
    pal.append(b);
  });
}
function add(i){if(run&&gs.length<cl)gs.push(i)}
function del(){if(run)gs.pop()}
function sub(){
  if(!run||gs.length<cl)return;
  let b=0,w=0;const a=[],t=[];
  gs.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v==S[i])b++;else{a.push(v);t.push(S[i])}});
  a.forEach(v=>{const j=t.indexOf(v);if(j>=0){w++;t.splice(j,1)}});
  rows.push({g:gs,b,w});gs=[];
  if(b==cl)end(1);
  else if(rows.length>=tries)end(0,'💥 Hết lượt! Mã là '+S.map(i=>EM[i]).join(' '));
}
function upd(){}
function draw(){
  C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const rh=Math.min((H-180)/tries,44), x0=(W-(cl+1.8)*rh)/2, y0=36;
  for(let i=0;i<tries;i++){
    const y=y0+i*rh+rh/2, R=i<rows.length?rows[i]:i==rows.length?{g:gs}:null;
    for(let j=0;j<cl;j++){
      const v=R&&R.g[j]!=null?R.g[j]:-1;
      C.beginPath();
      C.arc(x0+j*rh+rh/2,y,rh*.36,0,Math.PI*2);
      if(v>=0){C.fillStyle=CL[v];C.fill()}
      else{C.strokeStyle=i==rows.length?'#94a3b8':'#334155';C.lineWidth=2;C.stroke()}
    }
    if(R&&R.b!=null){
      for(let k=0;k<cl;k++){
        const bx=x0+cl*rh+rh*.3+(k%3)*rh*.4, by=y-rh*.2+Math.floor(k/3)*rh*.4;
        C.beginPath();
        C.arc(bx,by,rh*.12,0,Math.PI*2);
        if(k<R.b+R.w){C.fillStyle=k<R.b?'#000':'#fff';C.fill();C.strokeStyle='#fff';C.lineWidth=1.5}
        else{C.strokeStyle='#334155';C.lineWidth=1.5}
        C.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
  h.textContent=`Màn ${lv}/${N} · Lượt ${Math.min(rows.length+1,tries)}/${tries} · ⚫ đúng chỗ, ⚪ sai chỗ`;
}
onkeydown=e=>{
  const k=e.key;
  if(k>='1'&&k<='8'&&+k<=nc)add(+k-1);
  else if(k=='Backspace')del();
  else if(k=='Enter')sub();
};
menu();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script></body></html>
